title: js-xdr 4.x default decode depth (200) refuses valid deeply nested values that the 5.x line decodes
severity_basis: A valid value is refused with "exceeded max decoding depth" by the js-xdr 4.0.0 that the 16.x SDK line installs; js-xdr 5 raised the default to 1500. The 16.x line is a maintenance line.

entries.expected: decode values nested as deeply as stellar-core and the host admit
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: 'exceeded max decoding depth'. js-xdr 4.0.0's default depth of 200 allows about 66 nested vectors; js-xdr 5 (the v17 line) raised it to 1500.

entries.expected: decode values nested as deeply as stellar-core and the host admit
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: 'exceeded max decoding depth'. js-xdr 4.0.0's default depth of 200 allows about 66 nested vectors; js-xdr 5 (the v17 line) raised it to 1500.

entries.expected: the ledger decodes: the network accepted it, and js-xdr 5 (the 17.x line) decodes it
entries.observed: reject: 'XDR Read Error: exceeded max decoding depth' on js@16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1 (16.3.x on the Protocol 29 variants only; Protocol 30 is beyond their schema)

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L0, on js@16.3.0 - 16.4.1: the two limits/scvec-nesting entries and the deep ledger entry cap-0046/scval-nested-vec-99-in-event.
evidence.post_fix: js@17.2.0 and later (js-xdr 5) decode the same values.
evidence.expected_basis: The values are within the Soroban host limits (DEFAULT_XDR_RW_LIMITS depth 500, soroban-env-host v30.0.0 budget/limits.rs).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 6 of 6 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0022.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added. The 16.x maintenance line receives critical security fixes only (js-stellar-sdk SECURITY.md); no backport request is drafted unless a maintainer decides to ask for one.
